content_blocks.code: Framework guidance: let the framework own rendered markup and state. Prefer a framework-aware component integration or initialize a Bootstrap plugin only for a clearly separated DOM subtree.

content_blocks.title: Version and implementation note
content_blocks.text: A framework and a Bootstrap JavaScript plugin should not independently mutate the same DOM subtree. Prefer framework-aware components or establish clear ownership boundaries.
